'''Abhishek Dhar''' (born 31 August 1970) is an Indian physicist specialising in [[statistical physics]] and [[condensed matter physics]]. He is a professor at the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences, [[Bangalore]].<ref name="people">{{cite web|title=People|url=https://www.icts.res.in/people/1/details/90/|publisher=International Centre for Theoretical Sciences|access-date=4 November 2015}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Dhar obtained his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in 1998 from the Department of Theoretical Physics at the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]]. His doctoral advisor was [[Deepak Dhar]]. He did post-doctoral research at [[Indian Institute of Science]], [[Raman Research Institute]] and [[University of California, Santa Cruz]]. Dhar then became a faculty member of the Raman Research Institute and later joined the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences.<ref name="report">{{cite web|url=https://www.icts.res.in/sites/default/files/ICTS-Activity-Report-2015-2017.pdf|title=ICTS Activity Report 2015-17|access-date=25 July 2020}}</ref>

==Research==
Dhar works on the theory and applications of statistical physics to study non-equilibrium problems. His research areas include anomalous heat transport in  low dimensional systems<ref>{{cite journal|title=Anomalous heat transport in one dimensional systems|doi=10.3389/fphy.2019.00159|doi-access=free|arxiv=1911.04457}}</ref> and [[open quantum system]]s where he made significant contributions in  developing an approach using quantum Langevin equations. Dhar also studies large deviations and fluctuation theorems in transport, foundational aspects of statistical mechanics, the measurement problem in quantum mechanics and models of  [[active matter]].

==Awards==
For his results in classical and quantum transport in low dimensional systems and contributions to non-equilibrium [[fluctuation theorem]]s, Dhar was awarded the [[ICTP Prize|ICTP prize]] in 2008<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/prizes-awards/the-ictp-prize/the-prize-winners/ictp-prize-winners-2008.aspx|title=ICTP Prize Winners 2008}}</ref> and [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology|Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar award]] for Physical Sciences in 2009.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/Detail.aspx?AID=127|title=Brief Profile of the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar prize Awardee}}</ref> He is a fellow of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]] (2012),<ref>{{cite web|url=https://fellows.ias.ac.in/profile/v/FL2012005|title=Prof. Abhishek Dhar elected as IAS fellow}}</ref> the [[National Academy of Sciences, India|National Academy of Sciences]] (2018)<ref>{{cite web| url=https://www.icts.res.in/news/abhishek-dhar-elected-fellow-national-academy-sciences-india| title=Abhishek Dhar elected as a fellow of the National Academy of Sciences, India}}</ref> and the [[Indian National Science Academy]] (2020).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.icts.res.in/news/prof-abhishek-dhar-awarded-insa-fellowship|title=Abhishek Dhar awarded INSA Fellowship}}</ref>
